request.merge: median of pass scores per task

scale.0: AI cannot meaningfully help with this task.
scale.50: AI or a smart device can do a substantial part, but a person prepares, supervises, or finishes it.
scale.100: AI or a device can complete the task to an accepted result without a person doing the task.

prompt.system:
You rate recurring household and personal-administration tasks for AI Countdown, a project that measures how much human work AI can already take on.

Judge the task as it can be completed today in a typical home, not a research demo and not a future promise. Include software AI, voice and vision models, agents that use apps, and commercially available smart-home devices or mechanisms such as dishwashers, washing machines, dryers, robot vacuums/mops, smart feeders, and window-cleaning robots. A device only counts for the part it actually performs; loading, unloading, preparation, moving obstacles, maintenance, checking, and decisions remain human work unless the task says otherwise.

Give one integer score from 0 to 100 for each task:
- 0: AI cannot meaningfully help with this task.
- 50: AI or a smart device can do a substantial part, but a person prepares, supervises, or finishes it.
- 100: AI or a device can complete the task to an accepted result without a person doing the task.

Rate the complete task, including setup, supervision, quality checking, exception handling, and putting things away where relevant. Judge capability rather than household adoption, price, legal permission, or whether a specific family owns the device. Return a short rationale in English (at most 24 words) naming the main human remainder.

Return exactly one rating for every task id you receive.

make-bed.rationale: No available device can make a bed; human must do it entirely.

dishes-and-dishwasher.rationale: Dishwasher washes, but human scrapes, loads, unloads, and puts dishes away.

wipe-kitchen-surfaces.rationale: No device can physically wipe counters; human must do it entirely.

take-out-trash.rationale: No device can collect and take out trash; human must do it entirely.

tidy-hotspots.rationale: No device can sort and put away scattered items; human must do it.

spot-floor-cleanup.rationale: Robot vacuum handles crumbs, but human manages wet spills, obstacles, and checking.

wipe-bathroom-fixtures.rationale: No device can physically wipe bathroom fixtures; human must do it entirely.

feed-pets-and-litter.rationale: Smart feeder and litter box automate routine feeding/scooping, but person refills, empties waste, and monitors pets.

walk-dog.rationale: No available device can walk a dog; human must do it entirely.

cook-meals.rationale: Smart oven or cooker cooks, but human plans, preps, loads, monitors, and plates meals.

water-plants.rationale: Smart irrigation waters automatically; human installs, refills, checks plants, and handles leaks.

sort-mail-packages.rationale: Smart reminders track deliveries, but human sorts, opens, decides, and discards mail.

household-reminders.rationale: AI captures, schedules, and reminds; human still decides priorities and marks completion.

wet-clean-floors.rationale: Robot mop handles accessible floors; human clears obstacles, refills, cleans edges, and checks results.

vacuum-carpets-upholstery.rationale: Robot vacuum does carpets; human clears, handles upholstery, stairs, edges, and empties.

change-bedding-towels.rationale: No device can physically strip, replace, or launder bedding; human does all.

laundry.rationale: Washer/dryer automate wash and dry; human sorts, loads, transfers, folds, and puts away.

deep-bathroom-cleaning.rationale: No available device performs scrubbing, disinfecting, or toilet cleaning; human does all.

dust-surfaces.rationale: No available device dusts surfaces, sills, and appliances; human does all.

refrigerator-audit.rationale: Smart fridge tracks inventory/expiry; human inspects spoilage, discards, and cleans.

grocery-shopping.rationale: AI plans list and delivery orders; human approves, handles substitutions, receives, and stores.

meal-planning.rationale: AI plans meals and lists; human prepares ingredients, cooks, and checks preferences.

restock-household-supplies.rationale: Smart inventory and delivery can order supplies; human approves, receives, and stores them.

pet-grooming.rationale: Smart tools assist brushing or cleanup, but human handles pet, bathes, clips nails, cleans.

change-pet-bedding.rationale: Washer/dryer clean bedding; human removes, loads, replaces, and checks pet bedding.

sort-paperwork.rationale: Scanner/AI classify, but human feeds, decides retention, verifies, and files.

wash-trash-bins.rationale: No available device or AI can wash trash bins; a person must scrub, rinse, and dry them.

wipe-baseboards-doors-switches.rationale: No device can wipe these surfaces; a person must dust, scrub, and reach edges and switches manually.

clean-windows-inside.rationale: Window robot can clean some glass, but a person must set it up, move it, clean frames and mirrors, and check streaks.
